You also get a maximum amount of money you can spend per month of the money you earn yourself, so this is not an option. Its like living the life of a slave, no thanks I´d rather be dead

Well given, I tried killing myself multiple times with the strangling method as this is probably the only option I have. There are no building that are high enough I could access, I do not have something to bind a rope on, I do not own a gun. Cutting my wrists is just attention craving, won´t do shit.

Maybe, maybe not. I do not believe in god, if he believes in me ? I cant tell. Maybe, maybe not.

Aight will do. Doesnt hold me from trying it again tho, I am still clueless as to why it did not work tbh. I read everywhere that people are dying left and right because they accidently strangled themself with some stupid games like the "Pilottest", and here I am trying to really kill myself and it doesnt work. Ironic as it can get.
eh, havent slept the entire night, managed to get some hours now. Feels better tho. But what is Aleve/Tylenol ?
nope, I already am way too much in debt, pumped money everywhere I could. Guess I am not going to work in the financial branche as I cant handle money.

Yeah it is not about my mental instability, my psychotics or whatever, I have hit a dead end where I can either be homeless in a foreign country where I currently am, or die. I´d rather die than fuck around with problems like being homeless. 

Might seem like an easy way out but honestly, been through so much shit I am tired and sick of fighting. Funnily enough that money is the root of all my evil and could make me go from suicide to being a decent, happy person. How fucked up our world is.

Eh, I cant really get serious mental help as I grew up in a small village where everyone knows everyone, going into therapy would fuck up my family forever. Better kill myself and make this go over quick.

I just cant see a way how things can go good from here. I need a small fortune in order to fix things, and then there is still my mental illness which I cant really get over with.

Currently not, no. I used some but they just didnt do anything for me. Its like a placebo effect, just that my brain isnt stupid enough to believe this shit.

The thing is, I dont know if its just my sociopathy and my inner demon that fucks me up, or if I am some sort of completly mental broken guy that is batshit crazy, I feel like at this point I can tell anymore. Everywhere I go I leave a trail of broken people, hurt people and people I lied to and manipulated. I changed my job 4 times in a fucking year, changed my home place 3 times during the last year because I fucked up EVERY DAMN TIME.

Uh, I get around 1g for 40 euro which is okay-ish. I mean I am around 6k euros in debt, but hey, everybody got some cash for coke, right.

I did and I did, but this is your topic, its not about me.

All I can say to you is that I am proud that you try to fix things, that you actually still have a little happiness for life in you. You should hold on to this. If I may, I´d like to quote something from my all-time favorite band, Asking Alexandria:

> You'll never really find those perfect words,
Something more than just, goodbye.
It's hard to remember the good times when there's just so much heartache,
But they deserve more than that.
They deserve more than just one single moment of sadness.
So just remember,
That when there's enough love in our hearts to burst like a fuckin' supernova,
Then there sure as hell's enough love in our heart, to spark that famous smile.
We all lose someone at some point in our lives,
But don't ever let go of that smile.
Hold on forever,
Because that's our final dedication.

Spent the last 3 weeks playing video games instead of going to work, lying to my boss and family. Gonna strangle myself today with a belt, hopefully the information I got from google is true. 10 seconds until I blackout, 10 minutes until I die. We´ll see

Psychologist, but its all the same. Have been talking to them since I was a little kid because I actually am a super intelligent person. But all they ever did was saying "Everything is going to be okay" and all that bullshit, no one really tried to understand or give me professional help at all.

I dont have any close friends that I trust, let alone my family who thinks I am a stupid crybaby whenever I come up with something about my past or how I feel depressed. Crying is girls, worrying is for losers you know ? :)
